comment: REHEARSAL of 6 Oct 2026, NOT a result for the paper and NOT part of the campaign (md/test/REHEARSAL_2e.md). Three runs of the bonded parameter set 2e (MCPB.py step 2e, empirical zinc constants; terms at N2 as built BEFORE gate G-R, not validated), each with the full protocol of md/protocol.json unchanged (2 ns of equilibration) and 5 ns of production: TX0 from start X, TR0 from start R (the run in which the hydration check of the driver applies), TN0 from start N. They are written to /root/cqc-sfa-md/runs_test/bonded_2e/, never to runs/, which is for the campaign; every run folder gets a file REHEARSAL_NOT_A_RESULT.txt. One after another: each waits for the one before it, so a fault found in TX0 stops the other two. The run ids TX0, TR0, TN0 are not names of the plan (X0 is the validation run, X1..R3 the campaign): the analysis then gives no verdict of gate G-V and no campaign table. The manifests say test_only false because the protocol and the equilibration are those of production; the folder and the marker file say what the runs are. Watchdog on the Pi (ops/pi/cqc_gpu_watchdog.py, read 6 Oct 2026): it does not pull runs_test/, so its estimate lists these three as runs whose pull is pending; they are fetched by hand (md/test/REHEARSAL_2e.md).

tasks.title: REHEARSAL (not a result): run TX0, set 2e, start X, 2 ns of equilibration and 5 ns
tasks.command: mkdir -p "$RUNS/$MODEL/TX0" && echo "REHEARSAL of 6 Oct 2026, not a result for the paper: parameter set 2e, terms at N2 not validated by gate G-R, one run of 5 ns. See md/test/REHEARSAL_2e.md." > "$RUNS/$MODEL/TX0/REHEARSAL_NOT_A_RESULT.txt" && "$PY" "$MD/run_md.py" --system "$SYS/$MODEL/X" --out "$RUNS/$MODEL/TX0" --run-id TX0 --platform CUDA --stage all --prod-ns 5 --segment-ns 5 --resume
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$RUNS/$MODEL/TX0/manifest.json" run_id=TX0 status=complete production.complete=true production.completed_ns=5 test_only=false

tasks.title: REHEARSAL (not a result): run TR0, set 2e, start R (hydration check applies), 2 ns of equilibration or more and 5 ns
tasks.command: mkdir -p "$RUNS/$MODEL/TR0" && echo "REHEARSAL of 6 Oct 2026, not a result for the paper: parameter set 2e, terms at N2 not validated by gate G-R, one run of 5 ns. See md/test/REHEARSAL_2e.md." > "$RUNS/$MODEL/TR0/REHEARSAL_NOT_A_RESULT.txt" && "$PY" "$MD/run_md.py" --system "$SYS/$MODEL/R" --out "$RUNS/$MODEL/TR0" --run-id TR0 --platform CUDA --stage all --prod-ns 5 --segment-ns 5 --resume
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$RUNS/$MODEL/TR0/manifest.json" run_id=TR0 status=complete production.complete=true production.completed_ns=5 test_only=false

tasks.title: REHEARSAL (not a result): run TN0, set 2e, start N, 2 ns of equilibration and 5 ns
tasks.command: mkdir -p "$RUNS/$MODEL/TN0" && echo "REHEARSAL of 6 Oct 2026, not a result for the paper: parameter set 2e, terms at N2 not validated by gate G-R, one run of 5 ns. See md/test/REHEARSAL_2e.md." > "$RUNS/$MODEL/TN0/REHEARSAL_NOT_A_RESULT.txt" && "$PY" "$MD/run_md.py" --system "$SYS/$MODEL/N" --out "$RUNS/$MODEL/TN0" --run-id TN0 --platform CUDA --stage all --prod-ns 5 --segment-ns 5 --resume
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$RUNS/$MODEL/TN0/manifest.json" run_id=TN0 status=complete production.complete=true production.completed_ns=5 test_only=false
